description: This file defines the interface and data structures for the XR Speech Router Protocol SDT component, including function declarations, constants, and data types related to speech session management and network communication.

methods.name: xrsr_protocol_handler_sdt
methods.description: Handles the SDT protocol events and data processing for speech routing.

methods.name: xrsr_sdt_init
methods.description: Initializes the SDT state structure with provided parameters.

methods.name: xrsr_sdt_term
methods.description: Terminates and cleans up the SDT state structure.

methods.name: xrsr_sdt_host_name_set
methods.description: Sets the host name for the SDT connection.

methods.name: xrsr_sdt_fd_set
methods.description: Prepares file descriptor sets for network I/O.

methods.name: xrsr_sdt_handle_fds
methods.description: Handles activity on file descriptors for network communication.

methods.name: xrsr_sdt_connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection for the SDT protocol with specified parameters.

methods.name: xrsr_sdt_conn_is_ready
methods.description: Checks if the SDT connection is established and ready.

methods.name: xrsr_sdt_terminate
methods.description: Terminates the SDT connection and cleans up resources.

methods.name: xrsr_sdt_audio_stream
methods.description: Streams audio data through the SDT protocol.

methods.name: xrsr_sdt_send_binary
methods.description: Sends binary data over the SDT connection.

methods.name: xrsr_sdt_send_text
methods.description: Sends text data over the SDT connection.

methods.name: xrsr_sdt_read_pending
methods.description: Reads any pending data from the SDT connection.

methods.name: xrsr_sdt_speech_session_end
methods.description: Ends the current speech session with a specified reason.

methods.name: xrsr_sdt_handle_speech_event
methods.description: Handles speech events received during a session.

methods.name: xrsr_sdt_is_established
methods.description: Checks if the SDT connection is established.

methods.name: xrsr_sdt_is_disconnected
methods.description: Checks if the SDT connection is disconnected.
